name: mailmate-tracker1
description: Self-hosted open- and click-tracking endpoint for MailMate. Serves the pixel, classifies the fetch, and records it in a Cloudflare D1 database.

scripts.migrate:local: for f in migrate/data/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute mailmate-tracker --local --file="$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.migrate:remote: for f in migrate/data/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute mailmate-tracker --remote --file="$f" || exit 1; done
